scenes.title: The Assumption
scenes.spoken: kya tumhe bhi yahi lagta hai? Python language ka नाम…
scenes.concept: A confrontational kinetic-type cold open: PYTHON assembles letter by letter while a coiled line-art serpent and a huge question mark establish the assumption.
scenes.background: Midnight indigo editorial grid, radial spotlight, fine film grain and restrained chartreuse accents.
scenes.objects: Custom SVG serpent, sliced typographic masks, question-mark orbit and scanning rule.
scenes.typography: Space Grotesk 800 with faux-3D extrusion; Inter for Roman Hinglish spoken captions.
scenes.camera: Fast 4% push-in; slight perspective settling after the title lands.
scenes.transition: A chartreuse scan bar wipes into the snake hypothesis.
scenes.sfx: 0.08 s soft impact; 1.66 s title slam; 2.88 s whoosh.

scenes.title: Myth, Corrected
scenes.spoken: Python snake se relate karte hue rakha hai? But ye kahin bhi sahi nahi hai.
scenes.concept: The serpent is visually connected to Python, then the connection breaks and a decisive NOT THE SNAKE correction replaces it.
scenes.background: Deep navy with a drafting-board circle and restrained red correction marks.
scenes.objects: Animated SVG snake path, broken connector, circular strike and editorial labels.
scenes.typography: Condensed uppercase statement with mask reveal; oversized NAHIN as the emotional beat.
scenes.camera: Lateral drift followed by a rapid 6% punch on ‘NAHIN’.
scenes.transition: The strike circle becomes the rim of the 1989 timeline.
scenes.sfx: 4.30 s subtle digital ticks; 6.48 s low impact; 8.10 s morph whoosh.

scenes.concept: A monumental date emerges from a moving archival timeline; no unrelated historical imagery.
scenes.background: Warm charcoal paper texture meeting cool midnight blue, with a fine horizontal time ruler.
scenes.objects: 1989 extruded numerals, year ticks, a single glowing origin node and archival registration marks.
scenes.typography: Tabular Space Grotesk numerals, very large and tightly tracked.
scenes.camera: Timeline trucks left while the camera pushes toward the selected year.
scenes.transition: The origin node expands into Guido’s research blueprint.
scenes.sfx: 8.28 s year impact; 9.36 s soft clock tick; 10.34 s whoosh.

scenes.title: The Designer’s Brief
scenes.spoken: jahan par ek researcher Guido van Rossum ek aisi language chahta tha joki C se zyada fast ho, simple ho.
scenes.concept: A custom researcher identity card and code blueprint introduce Guido; FAST and SIMPLE become the two design requirements.
scenes.background: Cyan-on-navy technical drafting surface with depth-separated grid planes.
scenes.objects: GVR monogram, animated terminal lines, C block, two requirement cards and connecting paths.
scenes.typography: Editorial nameplate plus monospaced code and bold requirement labels.
scenes.camera: 2.5D parallax push through foreground grid, identity card and rear code plane.
scenes.transition: Terminal window folds into the laptop on the Christmas desk.
scenes.sfx: 11.05 s UI confirm; 14.86 s fast tick; 15.48 s simple chime.

scenes.title: A Christmas Side Project
scenes.spoken: wahi usi time apni Christmas ki chuttiyon mein ek hobby project start karta hai.
scenes.concept: A cinematic 2.5D winter workspace: snow beyond the window, warm practical lights and a laptop where a side project runs for the first time.
scenes.background: Cool blue night exterior contrasted with an amber interior, soft shadows and layered depth of field.
scenes.objects: Snow layers, window mullions, desk, coffee steam, fairy lights, laptop code and HOBBY PROJECT stamp.
scenes.typography: Small warm editorial labels; PROJECT START appears as a terminal confirmation.
scenes.camera: Slow lateral dolly and push-in; snow and desk move at different depths.
scenes.transition: Laptop screen zooms into the abstract 3D language core.
scenes.sfx: 16.60 s soft winter bell; 19.94 s project-start impact; 21.02 s screen whoosh.

scenes.title: The Language Core
scenes.spoken: jismein wo decide karta hai, main ek aisi language par work karunga joki C se zyada fast ho aur efficient ho.
scenes.concept: An original Three.js metallic code core assembles from wireframe to solid while FAST and EFFICIENT lock into orbit.
scenes.background: Dark technical void with volumetric-looking cones, sparse stars and a reflective floor grid.
scenes.objects: Real-time Three.js icosahedron, chrome torus rings, point particles, orbiting C badge and typographic gauges.
scenes.typography: Huge mask-revealed FAST and EFFICIENT; minimal monospaced annotations.
scenes.camera: Deterministic 3D dolly from 9 to 6.8 units with gentle orbital rotation.
scenes.transition: A chrome ring expands into a circular theatre spotlight.
scenes.sfx: 21.62 s decision click; 24.22 s core ignition; 25.84 s fast accent; 26.64 s efficient accent.

scenes.title: The Real Namesake
scenes.spoken: aur usne is language ka naam rakha ek British comedy show se relate karte hue, joki tha Monty Python’s Flying Circus.
scenes.concept: The technical world gives way to a custom retro theatre: curtains open, marquee bulbs illuminate and the comedy-show title takes the stage.
scenes.background: Burgundy velvet, brass trim, dark stage floor and two warm spotlight cones.
scenes.objects: Curtains, animated marquee, vintage title card, playful geometric circus orbit and subtle Union-Jack-inspired corner stripes.
scenes.typography: Vintage serif-like stage lettering paired with clean Space Grotesk title blocks.
scenes.camera: Proscenium dolly-in with a gentle handheld-free float; title cards arrive word by word.
scenes.transition: Marquee bulbs fly forward and resolve into the Python name reveal.
scenes.sfx: 27.62 s curtain whoosh; 29.66 s marquee click; 32.28 s three soft show-title hits.

scenes.title: Python Gets Its Name
scenes.spoken: isi ke naam par usne apni language ka naam rakha — Python.
scenes.concept: A direct visual match: MONTY PYTHON collapses to a single glowing PYTHON nameplate and original two-colour Python-inspired mark.
scenes.background: Clean midnight stage with ivory title card, blue/yellow brand accents and restrained spotlight.
scenes.objects: Connecting name line, custom interlocking Python mark, extruded title and small naming seal.
scenes.typography: PYTHON in massive 3D-shadowed capitals; Monty Python source line remains secondary.
scenes.camera: Quick push on ‘Python’, then a controlled half-second hold.
scenes.transition: The nameplate’s central node detonates into the invention network.
scenes.sfx: 34.16 s connection tone; 36.86 s naming impact; 37.32 s ignition whoosh.

scenes.title: An Invention Expands
scenes.spoken: ye Python language ek itna bada invention hai, जोकि…
scenes.concept: One small origin node branches into an increasingly dense connected system, making ‘how big an invention’ visible rather than literal.
scenes.background: Deep blue network space with architectural grid and depth-faded nodes.
scenes.objects: Animated SVG connections, moving pulses, expanding rings and an INVENTION central label.
scenes.typography: INVENTION appears inside a technical focus frame; scale words stay sparse.
scenes.camera: Pull-back reveals the network’s scale as new branches appear.
scenes.transition: Three primary branches become the ML, AI and automation panels.
scenes.sfx: 37.48 s low ignition; 38.90 s expansion impact; 40.02 s tri-panel whoosh.

scenes.title: Three Fields, One Language
scenes.spoken: machine learning, artificial intelligence, automation jaise sectors mein kaafi important role play karti hai.
scenes.concept: Three synchronized custom infographics: a neural graph for ML, a living processor for AI and an articulated robotic arm for automation.
scenes.background: Three premium glass/metal instrument panels over a shared dark grid; cyan, violet and amber distinguish the fields.
scenes.objects: Neural nodes, chip traces, robotic joints, gear teeth, data rails and sequential status lines.
scenes.typography: Large numbered domain names; IMPORTANT ROLE resolves as the shared conclusion.
scenes.camera: Virtual camera pans across the triptych, then lifts to show all three working together.
scenes.transition: Panels collapse to one small origin cube, matching the final reflection.
scenes.sfx: 40.18 s ML ping; 40.94 s AI ping; 42.49 s automation servo; 44.50 s shared impact.

scenes.title: From Side Project to Ecosystem
scenes.spoken: socho, ek us purane time ka chhota sa invention, jiski wajah se aaj kitna bada ecosystem ban chuka hai.
scenes.concept: The tiny origin cube returns, then grows into a luminous Three.js ecosystem globe surrounded by the three fields and a 1989-to-today arc.
scenes.background: Cinematic midnight-to-dawn gradient with a fine orbital horizon and atmospheric particles.
scenes.objects: Three.js network sphere, orbiting rings and points; domain satellites, 1989 origin marker and final Python mark.
scenes.typography: Small idea, big ecosystem: SMALL IDEA scales into ECOSYSTEM; final 1989 → TODAY lockup.
scenes.camera: Measured 3D pull-back, final two-degree rise and stable end hold.
scenes.transition: Clean final hold; music and visual motion resolve with the last spoken word.
scenes.sfx: 46.38 s reflective tone; 49.00 s growth whoosh; 50.96 s final warm impact; 52.08 s soft resolve.
